rust_toolchain.pin_mechanism: ARG RUST_VERSION=1.93.1 and ENV RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=${RUST_VERSION} in Dockerfile; rust-toolchain.toml in repo root. See fips/toolchain_pin.md for the consolidation rationale.

notes: OQS_DIST_BUILD=ON prevents AVX/AVX2 divergence across CPU microarchitectures
OQS_BUILD_ONLY_LIB=ON skips test artifacts that are not needed for the module
-ffile-prefix-map strips absolute build paths from object files (C side); --remap-path-prefix is the Rust equivalent and is documented as optional hardening in fips/gate1_golden.md Section 9
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1772150400 enforces deterministic timestamps in all build artifacts (epoch chosen at toolchain consolidation on 2026-05-28)
Line endings are enforced LF repo-wide via .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf) — required for cross-host bit-identical builds; see fips/gate1_golden.md Section 5

build_commands.step_3_integrity_reference: cargo run -p xtask -- write-integrity-reference target/release/libandna_ffi.so target/release/libandna_ffi.integrity

approved_mode_feature_set.description: Approved Mode requires all three features in 'required_features' to be enabled and both features in 'prohibited_features' to be absent. Crate-root compile_error! gates enforce that exactly one of 'fips-integrity-stub' or 'fips-integrity-hmac' is selected. The 'stub' feature in andna-mldsa44 is an always-pass CI bootstrap shim and must never be present in an Approved Mode artifact. The 'fips-integrity-stub' feature is development-only and must never be present in an Approved Mode artifact.

gate2_reference.note: Toolchain-independent; reproduced across all lanes during the fips/acvp-diagnostics and fips/hmac-integrity sprints. Unchanged by the ACVP KAT swap, the toolchain bump from 1.76.0 to 1.93.1, the line-endings fix, or the HMAC software integrity addition.

cargo_lock.note: Cargo.lock is committed to the repository and pins all transitive Rust dependencies. Must not be regenerated between build and validation. Lock format v4 requires Rust >= 1.78; the pinned 1.93.1 toolchain handles it natively.

non_claims: This document does not constitute FIPS 140-3 validation.
FIPS 140-3 validation requires testing by an accredited CST laboratory under a CMVP contract.
The Gate 1 bundle certifies build reproducibility within the defined build lane only.
No CAVP certificates have been issued for ML-DSA-44, SHAKE256, or HMAC-SHA-256 in this module as of the document date.

The HMAC-SHA-256 integrity key is a non-secret software-integrity test key embedded in the module. The integrity check detects unauthorized or accidental modification under the approved build and deployment process; it is not claimed to defend against a fully privileged adversary capable of rewriting both the module binary and its associated integrity reference file. See fips/algorithm_inventory.md Section 7.

The software-integrity self-test relies on the runtime environment to honestly identify the module file via ANDNA_INTEGRITY_MODULE_PATH and the associated reference file via ANDNA_INTEGRITY_REF_PATH. These environment variables are treated as trusted deployment configuration: within the trust boundary of the operator's deployment but outside the cryptographic module boundary.
